property_summary: For all inputs, only the contract owner can change rewardDistributor via setRewardDistributor (so after addReward by owner the rewardDistributor remains equal to the initial owner-set value); the mutant that removes onlyOwner allows arbitrary callers to change rewardDistributor, so for some fuzzed caller the distributor will differ.
change_summary: Remove onlyOwner guard so anyone can call setRewardDistributor, allowing rewardDistributor to be changed to a different value by any caller.
mutated_unit_code: function setRewardDistributor(address _distributor) external { rewardDistributor = _distributor; emit UpdatedRewardDistributor(_distributor); }
